hypotheses.Q1_rank64_captures_site_fisher: The frozen rank-64 quotient captures at least 70% of median per-site Fisher trace on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q2_rank64_recovers_half_oracle_effect: Rank-64 exact KL is at least half the per-example joint oracle on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q3_rank64_recovers_oracle_direction: Rank-64 has median downstream Fisher fidelity at least 0.50 to the per-example oracle effect on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q4_rank128_is_near_full_frozen: Rank-128 exact KL is at least 80% of full-frozen KL and its oracle-effect fidelity is within 0.10 of full-frozen on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q5_full_frozen_recovers_oracle_direction: The full frozen metric reaches median oracle-effect Fisher fidelity at least 0.70 on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q6_rank128_ood_fidelity_is_stable: Rank-128 oracle-effect fidelity drops by at most 0.15 from FineWeb to WikiText.
